Preserve the caller factory-unit demand; do not divide by 6.5 million lifetime tonnes, apply the 50% split again, add electrolysis infrastructure or treat this as one kg of aluminium casting. Both records retain nominal 21,700 m2 hall, 2,000 m3 multistorey building, 2,000,000 kg machinery and 909 m3 concrete. Source normal-strength concrete market mix becomes native foundation/sole-plate concrete; concrete specification and upstream burdens differ. Source regional concrete-disposal mix becomes native Swiss final building-concrete disposal at its original 2,000,000 kg. Building/machine composition, decommissioning, geography and uncertainty remain screening differences.

Copper wire drawing is a complete rod-production/further-drawing service per kg of separately supplied copper, not a finished copper-wire material or one kg copper purchase. Source/native2026 documentation explicitly excludes the main copper and balances only unrecovered scrap losses with 0.039644 kg internal copper; native2025 shorter documentation and its matching small internal copper demand support the same service boundary. Keep the caller main copper and native internal loss replacement separately; no second kg of copper, scrap-recovery credit, wire cross-section/volume/density conversion or extra rolling stage is added. The service is an older EU average estimated from aluminium-processing data; native label alone is not proof of representative modern copper-plant performance.

Both source and native retain 0.44667 kWh electricity and 1.4286e-9 rolling-mill units per service kg. Native purchases 0.80011 MJ natural-gas combustion and 0.80011 MJ light-fuel-oil combustion, while source purchases 0.720099 and 0.7601045 MJ useful heat. Fuel-input MJ and purchased heat differ in basis: no efficiency or energy-balance correction is inferred. Complete native ENTSO-E electricity, Swiss combustion/treatment, water/emissions and vintage replace source supply portfolios. Native upstream-material freight is included but final customer delivery is excluded, as source service documentation also states; independent caller delivery remains. Native complete corrugated packaging, internal lubricants, replacement steel plus its sheet-rolling service, waste oil and hazardous/municipal treatment stay once, without a second box or shaping service. These facts do not grant standalone chemical, packaging or treatment-flow equivalence.
